name: devmart
description: DevMart E-commerce Monorepo — Backend + Frontend + Shared Models

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && npx ng serve --proxy-config proxy.conf.json
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run build:backend" "npm run build:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd shared && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
